cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The default sandbox denied binding a real pathname Unix socket needed by the remediation-5 OS peer-identity probe.
impact: The first in-sandbox run could not exercise the real endpoint boundary; no product trust check was weakened. The same probe passed after minimum scoped OS socket/process access was granted.
lesson: When acceptance depends on OS endpoint identity, record sandbox limits and use the smallest controlled elevation rather than replacing the probe with an in-process fake.

cause: The remediation-5 package-local focused gate and adversarial probes passed after the real external Unix endpoint harness was corrected.
impact: The compiler host boundary, proof admission, serialization rejection, fork rejection, endpoint identity checks, and existing effect/risk/port/NL/replay/reservation behavior passed the package-local gate.
lesson: Keep package-local host-boundary correctness separate from production host wiring and release acceptance.

cause: Self-review confirmed that the package-local authority boundary is external-endpoint and OS-identity based, while C0 legacy issuer and production host wiring remain explicit open dependencies.
impact: The remediation does not claim that deployment configuration, runtime host cutover, browser acceptance, real providers, or release integration are complete.
lesson: Carry explicit external wiring and legacy issuer dependencies into the next integration line instead of treating the local compiler gate as a release claim.

cause: The remediation-5 package-local compiler authority boundary passed the controlled host-socket focused gate, adversarial probes, compile check, diff check and formal verification.
impact: The formal line closes at its package-local boundary. C0 legacy issuer retirement, production host wiring, catalog integration, Agent/Notebook cutover, provider, browser, full-gate, merge and release evidence remain separate and are not claimed.
lesson: Close package-local trust-boundary work only at its verified evidence boundary and carry catalog, host wiring and consumer integration gaps to the owning integration line.
